config.author: Rahul Kumar Singh; prepared by ML improvement engineer
config.commit_note: Source commit before this document; the first git commit containing protocol.json is the preregistration event and is pinned by the freeze.

prospective.inconclusive_rule: Fewer than 25 eligible campaigns: INCONCLUSIVE_SAMPLE; counts only, no performance metrics; extension requires new preregistration before further metric access.

mode_a: H1: candidate improves campaign recall over baseline
H2: candidate improves mature-alert precision over baseline
H3: gains do not depend on explicit recall mentions
mode_b: H1: prospective replication of historical baseline estimates; no improvement hypothesis

primary_metrics.campaign_recall: unique eligible campaign hits / all unique vehicle campaigns in the 2027-2028 campaign window and unchanged scope; unknowns and misses retained
primary_metrics.mature_alert_precision: confirmed full-364-day-follow-up alert episodes / all full-follow-up alert episodes issued in the flag window; confirmation uses outcomes through cutoff

secondary_metrics: ECE and Brier only if a calibrated probability is used

gates.mode_a_confirmed: Lower paired cluster-bootstrap difference bound > 0 for BOTH primary metrics, for every preregistered bootstrap seed.
gates.mode_a_failure: Either primary estimate below concurrent baseline, or loss in either development fold.
gates.mode_b: Estimate prospective baseline replication with intervals. Do not apply improvement gates or claim improvement.
gates.inconclusive: Insufficient campaigns or differences not separated from zero. Target met and improvement confirmed are separate statuses.

config.phase2_selection_rule: A candidate is defensible only if it does not lose on either primary metric in either fold; and it improves at least one primary metric in both folds; and the lower bound of the paired campaign-cluster bootstrap difference for that metric is greater than 0. Otherwise freeze the baseline.

selection_details.undefined_metrics: Cannot establish no loss or improvement; therefore not defensible.
selection_details.same_metric: The same primary metric must improve in both folds, with positive lower bounds for all five seeds.
selection_details.tie_break: First qualifying method in preregistered order; no seed selection.
selection_details.gradient_boosting: Not included: unnecessary complexity and additional inference serializer for this tiny corpus.
selection_details.logistic_fit: numpy standardized L2 logistic, fixed C=1, 1000 gradient steps, learning rate 0.1; no calibration unless independently supportable inside fit fold.
selection_details.calibration: No validation-fold calibration. If support is inadequate, no calibrated-score claim.

config.feature_note: Structured prior counts only. Defect label is a fixed grouping/matching identity, not encoded label text or a target-derived numeric feature. No recall text, campaign text, label text, severity or embedding features.

uncertainty.clusters: Connected components of campaigns linked by any matched alert across both methods; unmatched alerts form key/date components, shared between methods when identical. This retains false-positive denominators.
uncertainty.invalid_draws: Retain count; intervals unavailable if fewer than 95% of draws have defined denominators.
uncertainty.replication: Mode B estimates only; candidate-minus-baseline differences inapplicable.

custody.storage: Human-managed encrypted APFS disk image outside the repository; volume label RCA-PROSPECTIVE
custody.threat_model: Tamper-evident, not access-control. Public NHTSA outcomes can be re-fetched. No-peeking is honor-system; same-account access is not prevented.

config.snapshot_schedule: Quarterly preferred; annual minimum in 2027-2028, plus a final outcome snapshot through 2029-12-31. No collection during this task.
config.analysis_input_contract: Raw snapshots remain external. Final preprocessing uses the frozen original parsers and requires complete externally supplied version-consistent model classification artifacts; no paid calls or silent unknown-label imputation. No human-label claim. Missing pinned-model coverage makes analysis unavailable.
